summary:
The record reflects two distinct injury episodes. The first predates the motor vehicle accident at issue: on September 3, 2022, the patient sustained severe neck pain and stiffness during a weightlifting accident at the gym, reportedly occurring during a heavy squat set, evaluated by Dr. Alistair Finch at Back & Spine Restoration Center (though the record notes a discrepancy regarding the exact injury date). An intake questionnaire was completed September 10, 2022, and on September 12, 2022, Dr. Finch diagnosed acute cervical strain with possible underlying cervical disc herniation or bulge, noting the patient had prior treatment for cervicalgia in 2022, before the motor vehicle accident. A three-view cervical spine X-ray on September 15, 2022, showed mild degenerative disc disease at C5-C6 with a 4mm posterior disc bulge — later characterized elsewhere in the record as a pre-existing finding predating the September 2023 incident, though Dr. Elizabeth Foster's hospital notes describe the C5-C6 narrowing and bulge as of unclear onset.

The second, and primary, injury is the motor vehicle accident. The patient presented for emergency treatment culminating in surgery on September 4, 2023, at Littel Inc Emergency Hospital, where Dr. Elizabeth Foster performed emergency open reduction and internal fixation of left arm fractures (humerus and radius), with a nerve block tray administered for anesthesia. A CT scan of the head without contrast was performed September 5, 2023, and Acetaminophen 975mg was given September 6, 2023, for pain. Intraoperative fluoroscopic imaging confirming hardware placement was performed September 7, 2023, by Dr. Myrtle Turner.

Diagnoses following surgery included post-surgical left humerus and radius ORIF, cervicalgia, and left knee contusion. Physical therapy began September 15, 2023, at Lang-Weimann Medical Center under Robert Stewart, PT, DPT, continuing through December 8, 2023 (30 sessions total, discharged December 11, 2023), with repeated provocation of cervical symptoms. Medications included Oxycodone-Acetaminophen 5-325mg, Cyclobenzaprine 10mg (started October 19, 2023), and high-dose Ibuprofen 800mg (started November 16, 2023). Staples were removed September 21, 2023. The patient missed three consecutive PT sessions (November 14, 17, and 21, 2023), causing rebounded elbow stiffness. X-rays on October 19 and December 14, 2023, showed progressive healing; an MRI of the left upper extremity and C-spine was ordered December 14, 2023.

Care transitioned to Emory Sports Medicine Complex under Amanda Gregory, PT, OCS, beginning January 8, 2024, continuing through discharge March 22, 2024 (30 sessions), with recurrent cervical symptom provocation throughout. By February 8, 2024, Dr. Turner noted complete bony fusion but limited forearm/shoulder range of motion. At final discharge on March 25, 2024, the patient demonstrated a persistent 15-degree extension deficit in the left elbow and chronic pain despite substantial functional improvement.
